name: Regional Readiness Review
description: Zuzu and the neighborhood mentors review the whole Sonoran first act: bike repair, bridge engineering, desert ecology, water testing, materials work, and workshop building. Completing it turns the local adventure into the first wider-region travel plan.

steps.description: Show that the tires, brakes, and chain have all been checked or repaired.
Explain why the rebuilt bridge can carry force safely across the wash.
Compare desert plant observations with water-quality evidence from the Salt River.
Connect copper, workshop parts, and material testing to stronger future machines.
Add the first wider-region questions to the travel sketchbook: what resources and knowledge come from other places?
Receive the mentor clue that bridges, bikes, water loops, and tested materials can scale into spacecraft systems.

reward.label: Act 1 regional readiness
reward.childMessage: Your local tools are ready to grow into a wider map.
